method: Measured locally on 2026-11-21/22: Ryzen 7 5700X + RTX 2070 Super, Proton Experimental, legacy August 2023 VM build, 1200×720 window, dock scene, seed 1337, 30-second captures after warm-up. Bars show the mean game-loop time per tick (CPU work for Step + Draw); the GameMaker 1.4 runner is single-threaded, so this number decides the frame rate. Values are means of 2–3 serialized runs; run-to-run noise is about ±5 %.
